meta.name: product-description-generator
meta.description: E-commerce product description generator for any platform. Generates optimized titles, bullet points, descriptions, and backend keywords using competitor research + keyword scoring + FABE copywriting. Two modes: (A) Create — generate listing from product specs with optional competitor analysis, (B) Optimize — improve existing listing with keyword gap analysis. Supports Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Shopify, Etsy, TikTok Shop, Lazada, Shopee. No API key required. Use when: (1) writing a new product listing, (2) analyzing what makes competitors rank, (3) improving an underperforming listing.
